lines.text: Hattie the little hedgehog looked sadly at her forest friends playing in the clearing!
Bunnies had silky fur and puppies had soft paws, but Hattie was covered in stiff quills!
Why can't I be soft and fluffy like everyone else? she sighed to herself!
Suddenly, a giant red apple broke loose from the hilltop tree and rolled down fast!
It bounced straight toward the baby ducks splashing peacefully in the pond!
Hattie curled into a brave spiky ball and rolled directly into the giant runaway apple!
THUMP! Her sturdy quills pinned the apple instantly, saving all the ducklings!
What makes you different isn't a mistake—it's your one-of-a-kind superpower!
Celebrate being yourself and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
